Keep only the mask itself, including real metal side flanges that are visibly part of it. Neutral silver/charcoal grayscale ONLY, no imagined original-game colored finish. IDENTITY: Elder PHG from this specific community icon, not AVP Elder, Greyback, Golden Angel or the project's original elder.webp. Preserve the large rounded oval forehead disk with its raised oval border, its small irregular existing surface mark on the upper-left part of the disk and darker wear beneath, the shallow narrow eye slit shapes under the lower forehead edge, the comparatively plain lower face plate and the small visible rivet/perforation details already present. Keep the lateral flanges subordinate. No crown, horns or huge teeth, no fantasy additions.
